# Long lines

## A heading that is long but uses ordinary words and should wrap cleanly onto the next line without touching the body

## Setup `very_long_function_name_that_does_not_fit_in_the_heading_line_without_wrapping_or_hitting_the_margin`

The call `rect_mask(X, Y, x0, y0, w, h, extra, extra, extra, extra, extra, extra)` sits in a sentence that continues after the pill so a following line can be hit if the pill does not wrap.

```rustlab
result = very_long_identifier_without_spaces_that_exceeds_the_source_panel_width_and_runs_through_the_right_margin;
print("this_is_a_single_token_without_spaces_that_is_far_too_long_to_fit_on_one_line_of_the_output_panel_and_should_not_run_through_the_right_margin");
```

The paragraph after the cell stays clear of the output panel.
